name: heimdall
description: Command-gated PreToolUse guardrail that intercepts every Write/Edit/MultiEdit and forces a structured self-challenge against an extensible, file-type-aware checklist (backend + frontend) before the write lands. Real LLM judgment via a fast headless model, but the block/allow decision stays deterministic and outside the model: triviality escape hatch, fail-open on error, per-rule suppression, strict vs advisory modes, and an `ask` path for dependency upgrades. Dormant until /heimdall-on. Zero runtime dependencies (Node 16+).
